biggest_catch: You earn nothing until your referral completes the qualifying activities: for a personal referral, the friend must register before opening a new personal checking account within 90 days, then within 60 days of opening make 10+ Regions Visa debit purchases, post a $300+ ACH direct deposit, and enroll in Online Statements.
catches: Personal referral pays $50 only after the referred person registers for the program before opening a new Regions personal checking account within 90 days of the referral.
Within 60 days of account opening the referred person must post at least 10 Regions Visa debit card purchases, one ACH direct deposit of $300 or more, and enroll in Online Statements.

Business referral pays $150 only after the referred business registers before opening a new business checking account within 90 days (with $500 deposited the day the account opens), then makes at least one Visa Business debit purchase and enrolls in Online Statements within 60 days.
Maximum $500 per calendar year in referral rewards; if one person receives more than one referral, only the first referrer (per Regions records) is paid.
The reward is deposited to the referrer's Regions checking account within 60 days of requirements being met; the account must be open with a positive balance at payout.

Employees of Regions Bank, Regions Financial Corporation, and affiliates are not eligible; participants 18+ only; offer may be changed or ended without notice and cannot be combined with other offers.

c3.evidence: No participation fee; reward is deposited to the referrer's Regions checking account.

c4.evidence: Reward deposited within 60 days of all requirements being completed, directly to the referrer's open, positive-balance Regions checking account.

eligibility: Referrer must be a Regions customer 18+ with an open checking account with a positive balance. Employees of Regions Bank/Regions Financial Corporation and affiliates are not eligible. Referred Person/Business cannot have had an ownership interest in a Regions deposit account within 12 months of the referral; referrer and referred cannot be the same person or share an email address.
notes: Official Regions Bank Refer a Friend program rules (regions.com). Referrer earns $50 per qualifying personal-checking referral and $150 per qualifying business-checking referral, capped at $500 per calendar year. numeric_basis: payout from official Regions Refer a Friend Program Rules ($50 personal / $150 business per qualifying referral, $500/calendar year cap); time: register and send referral via Offer Tracker, est. 5-15 min active

Refer a business to Regions and earn a $50 reward for you and $150 reward for them when they open a business account.'

s2.evidence: Official Program Rules on regions.com give concrete referrer payouts: $50 per qualifying personal referral and $150 per qualifying business referral, with a $500-per-calendar-year maximum.

steps: Log in to Offer Tracker at regions.com with your Regions online banking credentials.
Click 'Send a Referral' under the Refer a Friend section and provide the friend's or business's contact information and email address.
Your friend or the business receives a referral email and must register for the program before opening a new Regions checking account.

The referred person opens a new Regions personal checking account within 90 days and completes the qualifying activities within 60 days of opening; for a business referral, the business opens a business checking account and completes its qualifying activities.
Your $50 (personal) or $150 (business) reward is deposited to your Regions checking account within 60 days of all requirements being completed, up to $500 per calendar year.
timing: Reward deposited directly to the referrer's Regions checking account within 60 days of all requirements being completed.
